sections.heading: For every kind of school and college.
sections.lede: Districts, private schools, and colleges buy and run programs differently. We plan around how yours works.

cards.title: K-12 School Districts
cards.subtitle: One campus or the whole district.
cards.body: We work directly with districts and handle DIR, OMNIA, NCPA, and E-Rate alongside your procurement office. The program runs as STEM and CTE, the kind of program boards approve and families support.

cards.title: Private, Charter & Magnet
cards.subtitle: A faster path to a new program.
cards.body: Private, charter, and magnet schools can often decide faster than a district. We keep that pace and deliver a STEM program that helps in enrollment conversations and keeps students engaged.

cards.title: Junior & Community Colleges
cards.subtitle: A way to recruit students and build pathways.
cards.body: Community colleges use esports to attract and keep students and to build workforce and CTE pathways. We build the room and the program structure that keeps it going.

cards.title: Universities
cards.subtitle: Scholarships, STEM research, and campus life.
cards.body: Universities build esports programs to compete for students, offer scholarships, and support STEM research. We build a facility sized to your program and your campus.

cards.title: Not sure where to start?
cards.body: Answer a few questions about your space and program, and we’ll send you a free readiness report.

faqs.q: Do we need to go through a bid process to work with TANCHES.GG?
faqs.a: Usually not. Our active DIR, OMNIA, NCPA, and E-Rate contracts let most public institutions buy from us without a separate RFP or bid. We can walk your procurement office through it.

faqs.q: Will this create problems for our district’s IT department?
faqs.a: No. We work with your IT department, not around it. We bring 28 years of enterprise IT to every build, and the networking, cybersecurity, and managed support are built to your IT team’s standards.

faqs.q: Does the facility qualify for E-Rate funding?
faqs.a: E-Rate gives federal discounts on networking and broadband for eligible K-12 schools and libraries. We’ll show you which parts of your build may qualify. Our SPIN is 143052684.

faqs.q: Is the curriculum STEM or CTE accredited?
faqs.a: Yes. We connect your program with STEM.org accredited curriculum partners, and CTE pathway alignment is available.

faqs.q: Can we start with a small deployment and expand later?
faqs.a: Yes. We can start with a small equipment deployment or a full facility build. We scope what you need now and plan for what comes next.

faqs.q: What happens after the facility is built?
faqs.a: Your first season starts with coaching, league registration, and student onboarding. After that, we provide ongoing technical, coaching, and program support.
